newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Venezuelan oil basket up $0.40 to $22.20.
newsitem.headline: Venezuelan oil basket up $0.40 to $22.20.

text.p: The average export price for Venezuela's basket of crude and oil products increased $0.40 to $22.20 per barrel on Friday, compared to $21.80 on Dec. 20, the last day it was registered, the Energy and Mines Ministry said.
The hike reflected higher demand due to the cold snap affecting most parts of Europe.
The average price for 1996 was $18.25 per barrel, the ministry said in a statement, sharply up from $14.84 in 1995. Venezuela's oil export price averaged $13.23 in 1994.
The Venezuelan government has based revised 1996 budget calculations on an average price of $17.00 per barrel.
